findings.description: storage_encrypted is set to false, so the RDS database is stored unencrypted on disk, exposing data at rest.
publicly_accessible is set to true, exposing the RDS instance directly to the internet, expanding the attack surface for the database.
The egress security group rule allows all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports and protocols, violating least-privilege network segmentation.
The policy grants wildcard actions on s3, ec2, and rds to all resources (*), far exceeding least privilege and enabling broad data access and modification from the EC2 instance.

The user_data script embeds the database password (${var.password}) in plaintext. This is stored in the Launch/instance user data and is readable by anyone with access to the EC2 metadata or the instance configuration.
